dialogues.text: ...W—We shouldn't do that, right? I mean, why can't we...
You good-for-nothing wimp! Since when did I say you could tell me what to do?
Quiet, fool! I hate you so much, you useless good for nothing! You ought to be left here alone to rot... You hear me? Now shut up and rot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sounds like two people are arguing. What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't like this! Paimon doesn't like this one bit! Paimon's getting mad!
